headline: Public docs teardown: highest-impact fixes and the automation layer to prioritize first

summary.executive_summary: Audit of portal.thirdweb.com (2,572 pages crawled, 100% coverage) reveals critical navigation and discoverability issues. 650 confirmed broken internal documentation links impair user journeys and SEO. API reference coverage is 12.91% across 2,110 detected API pages, leaving 87% of endpoints undocumented or poorly linked. Retrieval readiness scores 52.17/100 (weak band): only 14.07% of pages are answerable by AI, 58.32% are chunkable, and 86.42% carry stale-content risk. Example code reliability detection returned 0%, flagged as a likely JS-rendering limitation requiring manual review. Freshness metadata appears on only 1.01% of pages, obscuring content currency for users and search engines.

key_findings.headline: Undocumented API operations
key_findings.business_consequence: Generate/update reference + how-to from OpenAPI and enforce drift checks.

key_findings.headline: Code examples fail or are non-runnable
key_findings.business_consequence: Run smoke + expected-output checks and auto-fix broken snippets.

key_findings.headline: Documentation freshness debt
key_findings.business_consequence: Prioritize stale pages via weekly SLA loop and lifecycle policies.

priority_actions.title: Fix all 650 broken internal documentation links using automated link-check CI and bulk redirect/repair pass
priority_actions.why_this_first: Immediate SEO recovery, removes friction from onboarding and support escalation paths, and restores trust across the entire 2,572-page surface.

priority_actions.title: Inject last-updated timestamps and author metadata into all 2,572 pages via CMS automation or build pipeline
priority_actions.why_this_first: Low-effort change boosts user confidence, improves search ranking freshness signals, and enables stale-content triage workflows.

priority_actions.title: Generate usage examples and integration guides for the 1,835 undocumented API endpoints (87% gap) prioritized by traffic and support ticket volume
priority_actions.why_this_first: Directly reduces support load, accelerates developer time-to-value, and unlocks self-service for the majority API surface driving product adoption.

strengths: Full crawl coverage achieved: 2,572 of 2,575 discovered pages indexed with 95% crawl confidence
High citationability: 100% of pages support citation extraction for AI and support workflows
Strong evidence backing: 80.68% of 1,232 detected claims include supporting evidence or examples
risks: 650 broken internal links create dead ends, harm SEO authority, erode user trust, and block onboarding flows
87% of API surface (1,835 of 2,110 endpoints) lacks usage documentation, forcing users to reverse-engineer or contact support
Only 14.07% of pages are answerable by LLM retrieval systems, limiting AI assistant accuracy and self-service deflection
86.42% stale-risk score indicates widespread absence of freshness signals, risking user reliance on outdated instructions
limitations: External audit cannot verify correctness, accuracy, or versioning of code examples, API signatures, or technical claims—only structural presence and linking.
Example reliability score of 0% likely reflects JS-rendered code blocks invisible to static crawlers; manual or instrumented browser audit required for true reliability assessment.
Freshness and staleness metrics depend on visible metadata; pages may be current but lack last-updated stamps, inflating stale-risk percentage.
automation_first: Deploy CI link-check on every commit to prevent new broken links and auto-flag the existing 650 broken internal references for triage; expected payoff is zero new dead ends and 90% reduction in link-rot support tickets within 60 days.

Automate last-updated timestamp injection and stale-content alerts for pages older than 180 days (currently 86.42% at stale risk) using Git commit history or CMS webhooks; expected payoff is 50% faster content refresh cycles and measurable trust lift in user surveys.

Build API reference coverage dashboard tracking the 2,110 detected endpoints against usage-doc existence (currently 12.91% covered) with weekly Slack alerts for undocumented endpoints above P1 traffic threshold; expected payoff is 30% API doc coverage gain in 90 days and 20% drop in 'how do I use this endpoint' support tickets.
